title: Prometheus-alpha v0.4: can selection spread the copy through the body? Fission rules, a universal code, and single-cell memories
status: Locked before any v0.4 experiment on a confirmatory rule. F0 and F1 were training (from S0 and S1) when this was locked. No pilots were run; a code smoke test at n = 8 on pilot rule S102 checked only output shapes.

rules.F0, F1: each initialised from S0 / S1 and trained 2,000 iterations on lives in which, after conditioning, the worm is cut at site 20 (+-1) and the posterior half (70%) or the anterior half (15%) regrows for 48 steps, or the head is cut (15%); memory scored after regrowth

H19.claim: Fission, trained split: the posterior half (cut at site 20) regrows for 48 steps into a worm that remembers

H20.claim: Fission, held-out split: the same with the cut at site 24 and 64 steps of regrowth

H21.claim: Distributed copy: in intact trained worms, the hidden channels of sites 16-35 copied into the untrained twin make the twin's regrown head (after complete decapitation) remember, more in F rules than in the S sibling

H22.claim: F rules keep the S ability: memory survives complete decapitation

H23.claim: A universal code: the other S rule's v0.2 compiled patterns, written into this rule's untrained decapitated bodies, write the intended memory
H23.measure: (pref with its A pattern - pref with its B pattern) / 2

H24.claim: Single-cell memory: a pattern designed at site 14 only (32 design worms, seed 5240) writes a memory into held-out untrained decapitated bodies (seed 5241)

decision_rules.family: the hypotheses run in each rule; Holm at alpha 0.05; SESOI 0.10; replicated = supported in both rules of a family

predictions.H19: F: supported. S: not supported (v0.3 H18)
predictions.H20: F: supported, weaker than H19. S: not supported
predictions.H21: supported: to survive fission the copy must spread along the trunk
predictions.H23: not supported: independently selected rules invent their own codes (as Morpheus's bioelectric codes did not transfer)
predictions.H24: S and F: supported, partially (smaller than the four-cell 0.98). E: not supported
